## AuditRecordInput.argsSummary property

A redacted, human-readable summary of the call arguments — NOT the raw arguments, which may contain sensitive data. Example: "Calendar: Work; Summary: Team Meeting; Attendees: 3".

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly argsSummary: string;
```
